voltage-green.$description: Voltage Green — Green action color for filled buttons, selected navigation states, and focused conversion moments

alarm-red.$description: Alarm Red — Frame borders, decorative strokes, section dividers — the most-used border color in the system. Borders total 44 instances vs only 12 backgrounds, meaning red reads as a hard rectangular frame or alert outline rather than a surface fill

caution-yellow.$description: Caution Yellow — Yellow outline accent for tags, dividers, and focused UI edges

absolute-black.$description: Absolute Black — Page canvas, photo tile borders (104 image borders), all text colors. The most frequent single color in the system (3357 occurrences) — everything else floats on it

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Hairline borders, dividers, input outlines, and card edges on light surfaces.

ashen-gray.$description: Ashen Gray — Medium-contrast borders, control outlines, and structural separators.

offwhite.$description: Sole display and heading face, also used for buttons and links. The blocky pixel-inspired geometry of this custom face is the brand's most important asset — at 180–500px each letter becomes a sculptural object that photographs nest into. Weights 600/700 are reserved for display-scale usage; 400 carries inline link and button use.

times.$description: Sole body face. The deliberate collision of a conventional serif against the radical blocky display face is a core editorial gesture — Times reads as quiet annotation, the opposite of Offwhite's shout. Body text is always 16px, always Times, always 1.20 leading.

arial.$description: Rare utility use for small button labels and meta text where Times would feel too 'editorial.' Used sparingly (freq=6) — only when functional UI needs a neutral voice.
